title: consoleViteConfig
responsibility: Builds the console as one script and one stylesheet for hosts that serve it themselves.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: The default Vite configuration object for building the console library. It uses the Svelte plugin and the src/lib/development-tooling/console.ts library entry, and builds to dist/console as one iife script under the HarnessConsole global name with the file name console, with emptyOutDir enabled and CSS code splitting disabled, so a host serves the console as one script and one stylesheet; the Svelte plugin contains callback hooks that JSON cannot express.
